issues.summary: After B3.3 merge and canonical runtime restart, public /api/v1/analyze canary reached artifact runtime but terminalized with POST_COMPILE_OBSERVATION_EXECUTION_STALLED before physical probe proof.
issues.recommended_gate: Diagnose canary/public artifact terminalization around post-compile observation entry before rerunning FireTest 5.

issues.summary: /api/v1/chat OpenAPI advertises PublicRuntimeRequest, but live request with PublicRuntimeRequest returned ChatRequest validation errors requiring message and forbidding contract/payload fields.

evidence.observed_error: Field required: body.message; extra_forbidden: metadata, client_type, api_version, operation, contract, payload
evidence.workaround_for_diagnostic: Used /api/v1/analyze public bridge endpoint, which accepted PublicRuntimeRequest.

issues.recommended_gate: Clarify public chat route ownership/projection; this is secondary because /api/v1/analyze provided the public runtime bridge for canary.
